d: When her cow is killed by a train, Lucy Tutaine is outraged by the indifference to her financial loss.
Suspicious townspeople are drawn toward two brothers who spend their nights digging at a grave.
Reuel Gridley pays off a bet by donating a bag of flour to a fund for the Civil War wounded.
Farmer Carlo Farelli wants to marry beautiful saloon girl Della but must first deal with a town gangster.
A princess agrees to be treated by a medical pioneer who uses a new method: blood transfusion.

st: The Private Mint of Clark, Gruber and Co.
d: Plagued by gold thefts, Denver bankers set up their own mint in the bank basement.
A friendship grows between a wounded bandit and a French-Canadian engineer who nurses him back to health.
This ambitious frontier epic features a lawman (Kris Kristofferson) and a hitman (Christopher Walken) who fight in a tragic class war between ranchers and starving immigrants.

A bounty killer, Clips, has been for a long time on the trail of John Cooler, an elderly bandit whose head hangs a bounty of twenty thousand dollars. John is also wanted by the Mexican Juarez and his gang.

In 1854, fresh West Point graduates are sent to Kansas to help pacify the territory.  Standing in their way is insurrectionist John Brown, who is determined to overthrow the US government and establish and new abolitionist state.
Even though Doc has confessed to murdering the man that shot his horse, Matt is unwilling to arrest him.
Father Manogue faces a challenge from a corrupt gambler as he attempts to bring morality to Virginia City.

st: The Law of the Round Tent
d: An ex-convict dispenses law from his tent in a mining camp.
Stephen Austin travels with his companion Valdez to purchase land in the Mexican territory of Texas.
The mayor of El Paso seeks cleaner water for the city and attempts financing by a sale of Main Street.
A father who raised a cold-hearted killer worries his younger son may turn out the same way.
John Wheeler is going to even the odds in a fight between meek Arkie Monson and a gunslinger.
Wyatt Earp's brother Virgil masquerades as a bandit to gain access to an outlaw hide-out.
The Emperor of Brazil has an encounter with two imaginative youngsters while traveling to San Francisco.
Peaceful Jack Slade changes into a vengeful gunman after he's attacked by a thief.
Bill Franklin stumbles upon a rich gold vein and names it after his wife.
